statements.statement: The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The denial reason code is PR-204

Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess efficacy of current rate control management
